Name: line_fill_rate
Description: Share of non-cancelled order lines shipped complete on first release. Slice by CUSTOMER_NAME, THERAPEUTIC_CLASS, DC_ID, ORDER_MONTH or ORDER_CHANNEL.

Name: unit_fill_rate
Description: Units shipped as a share of units ordered.

Name: backorder_rate
Description: Units backordered as a share of units ordered.

Name: shipped_revenue
Description: Invoiced revenue from shipped units at the customer unit price.

Name: ordered_value_wac
Description: Demand at WAC list price; use for volume trends rather than revenue.

Name: backordered_value_wac
Description: WAC value of units placed on backorder at first release.

Name: on_time_ship_rate
Description: Shipped lines that left the DC on or before the promised ship date.
SQL: SUM(V_ORDER_LINE_DETAIL.IS_SHIPPED_ON_TIME) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN V_ORDER_LINE_DETAIL.ACTUAL_SHIP_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)

Name: on_time_delivery_rate
Description: Delivered shipments that arrived on or before the promised delivery date.
SQL: SUM(CASE WHEN SHIPMENTS.ACTUAL_DELIVERY_DATE <= SHIPMENTS.PROMISED_DELIVERY_DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN SHIPMENTS.ACTUAL_DELIVERY_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)

Name: stat_order_share
Description: Share of order lines placed at STAT priority. Slice by ORDER_CHANNEL to compare auto-replenish with other channels.
SQL: SUM(CASE WHEN V_ORDER_LINE_DETAIL.ORDER_PRIORITY = 'STAT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(V_ORDER_LINE_DETAIL.ORDER_LINE_ID), 0)

Name: open_backorder_count
Description: Number of backorders currently open as of 2026-09-25.

Name: open_backorder_value_wac
Description: WAC value of currently open backorders.

Name: aged_backorder_count
Description: Open backorders older than 14 days, the escalation threshold.
SQL: SUM(CASE WHEN V_BACKORDER_AGING.DAYS_OPEN > 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

Name: allocation_utilization_pct
Description: Consumed units as a percent of allocated units for allocated products.

Name: allocation_shortfall_units
Description: Units requested above what Halcyon could allocate.

Name: allocation_shortfall_value_wac
Description: WAC value of allocation shortfall.

Name: halcyon_allocation_units
Description: Manufacturer allocation to Halcyon for an NDC and month. Repeats per customer row so use MAX at NDC and month grain.

Name: cold_chain_excursion_rate
Description: Excursions as a share of monitored readings. Compare within the same STORAGE_CLASS and STAGE.

Name: excursion_count
Description: Number of temperature excursions.

Name: value_quarantined_or_destroyed_wac
Description: WAC value of product quarantined or destroyed after an excursion.

Name: expiring_90d_value_wac
Description: WAC value of inventory expiring within 90 days at the latest snapshot.

Name: expiring_30d_value_wac
Description: WAC value of inventory expiring within 30 days at the latest snapshot.

Name: inventory_value_wac
Description: On-hand inventory value at WAC at the latest snapshot.

Name: days_of_supply
Description: Available units divided by average daily demand at the latest snapshot; average across DC and NDC rows.

Name: expiry_write_off_risk_skus
Description: DC and NDC combinations where 12 weeks of demand cannot consume the units expiring in 90 days.

Name: chargeback_amount_claimed
Description: Total chargeback amount claimed from manufacturers.

Name: chargeback_dispute_rate
Description: Disputed or rejected claims as a share of claims submitted.

Name: chargeback_amount_disputed_or_rejected
Description: Chargeback dollars currently disputed or rejected; margin at risk.

Name: chargeback_avg_days_to_settle
Description: Average days from submission to settlement for settled claims.

Name: open_high_severity_cases
Description: Service cases not closed with HIGH or CRITICAL severity.
SQL: SUM(CASE WHEN SERVICE_CASES.STATUS <> 'CLOSED' AND SERVICE_CASES.SEVERITY IN ('HIGH','CRITICAL') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

Name: sla_attainment_rate
Description: Closed cases resolved within the severity SLA.
SQL: SUM(CASE WHEN SERVICE_CASES.SLA_MET THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN SERVICE_CASES.STATUS = 'CLOSED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)

Name: exec_escalation_count
Description: Service cases escalated to Halcyon leadership.
SQL: SUM(CASE WHEN SERVICE_CASES.ESCALATED_TO_EXEC THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

Name: operational_risk_score
Description: Transparent 0 to 100 triage score from V_CUSTOMER_HEALTH. Use MAX per customer; average only across customers when asked for a portfolio view.

Name: annual_contract_value
Description: Expected annual purchase value under the customer agreement.

Name: return_credit_amount
Description: Credit issued on customer returns.
